name: Volumetric Gaussian Splatting (AVIS)
definition: A research fork of 3D Gaussian Splatting adapted for volume-supervised training on 3D medical-style data (CT/MR). It optimizes a 3D Gaussian representation against a target volume inside a mask region of interest (ROI), using volumetric and mask-aware supervision on rasterized voxel grids instead of photometric losses on rendered camera views.
summary: Volumetric Gaussian Splatting adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting for medical volume reconstruction by optimizing against volumetric and mask-aware supervision on voxel grids instead of photometric losses on rendered views.
